pages.text: $(bold)Pressure Plates$() (wood = any entity, stone = mobs/players) and $(bold)Weighted Plates$() (output scales with how many items/entities) are the floor sensors. $(bold)Tripwire$() strung between two hooks fires when crossed — a hidden trigger across a doorway.
pages.title: Underfoot & Across

pages.text: $(italic)More Red's$() $(bold)Stone Plate$() is a sturdier pressure plate that fits its wiring aesthetic — same idea, matched to the rest of a red-alloy build.
